source: Raw evidence basis: managed-record-multiclient SSE capture via corpusctl --mode managed-record-multiclient at candidate 67718bc0342cc631f5fb963678b58f8338e0ca28 (clean tree; fu01-query-a.ndjson, fu01-query-b.ndjson, fu01-query-c.ndjson, fu01-capture-facts.json), which established the retained-frame shape (node-list refresh-ok for the peers already subscribed, init-tree refresh-ok for a late joiner per contract §4) and the deterministic facts replayed exactly below: a single committed admin change lands as trigger transaction watermark tx-id 2 on a fresh isolated database (seed tx 1), and every stream goes quiet inside a bounded 250ms window. This envelope's checked-in bytes are captured live from cmd/instantd/runtime_fu01_query_replay_test.go::TestFU01QueryCaptureReplay running that same shape against the owned deterministic query-concurrency-gap fixture (app 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003, fixed entity IDs) rather than replaying the recorder's random per-run UUIDs verbatim; the contract's shape-proof harness TestFU01CaptureContractQueryConcurrency and the accepted assembled leg TestCF003AssembledSSEQueryConcurrencyOrderedSnapshot share this same deterministic entity/title/event-id convention.
redaction: CF-002 discipline: volatile transport headers excluded; SSE heartbeat comment records excluded; the transport-level handshake hello frame is excluded from retention per contract §3. Masking rule (mechanical, enforced by the replay test): session-bearing and schema-minted string values are never checked in. The checked-in frames carry sentinel placeholders <fu01-session-C>, <fu01-attr-id-todos-id>, <fu01-attr-id-todos-title> in exactly the positions the live server emits random values (protocol-init session-id for the late joiner, schema attr ids embedded in the peers' node-list refresh triples). Entity IDs, the app ID, titles, op names, and event IDs are fixed literals chosen by the owned fixture and are never masked; they remain comparison-significant. No POST request/response bytes are checked in (see excluded). The replay test masks live frames back to the sentinels before whole-result reflect.DeepEqual; any checked-in real session value (any live-session-prefix substring) or missing sentinel fails the test before any byte is replayed. No timestamps, DSNs, or database URLs appear in these bytes.
excluded: Excluded with reason: (1) the transport handshake hello for the late joiner — excluded from retention by contract §3, asserted only for distinctness/freshness live, never checked in. (2) The trigger admin transact (POST /admin/transact, one entity retitled) — its response carries a per-database transaction watermark and its request carries the credential-bearing X-admin-token header; it runs live with a positive strictly-advancing tx-id asserted live (deterministic tx-id 2 on a fresh isolated database with the deterministic tx-1 seed from query-concurrency-gap.json's evidence, re-asserted exactly). (3) SSE POST request/response bytes for the late joiner's init and add-query — always exactly 200 {}\n regardless of session content; the cf003 helpers already assert this exactly live. Heartbeat comments are excluded per the redaction rule, not a behavior exclusion.
